Overview.Name: Anakatala Swaroopa
Overview.Goal: Support overall health, manage hypertension and joint pain, and maintain energy for daily activities.

Meal_1_Breakfast: 2 whole eggs pan fried in ghee
1 small bowl rice with cooked vegetables (bottle gourd, ridge gourd, beans, spinach)
Add a small portion of ghee to rice for satiety
Meal_2_Lunch: 2 whole eggs or 100g paneer lightly cooked in ghee
1 small bowl rice with vegetables (avoid potatoes)
Snack_Optional: Roasted makhana or puffed rice with a spoon of ghee and pinch of salt

Notes_and_Tips: Prioritize whole ingredients: eggs, paneer, curd, rice, and vegetables. Avoid processed foods and seed oils.
Keep cooking simple and quick — pan frying and boiling are ideal.
Since you cook for yourself, keep meal prep minimal and repetitive for ease.
Eat slowly and stop at comfortable fullness to support digestion and prevent overeating.
Yoga and gentle walking after meals can help with joint pain and blood pressure management.
For cravings, have savory snacks like puffed rice or makhana. Avoid fried and processed options.
Consistency is key for managing hypertension and joint pain.
